nodes.name: SDD Post-Session Hardening Proposal
nodes.summary: Proposes fixing 6 permanently-failing integration tests (caused by System:Self seeding baseline mismatch), aligning the TypeScript SDK AddMemoryRequest with 5 missing server fields, tightening VS Code extension type annotations, and adding inline documentation for decay scoring invariants and PPR/pinned separation. All changes are non-behavioral with no Rust production logic modifications.

nodes.name: SDD Post-Session Hardening Design
nodes.summary: Details design decisions for fixing test assertions using delta-relative counts (not backend bypass), extending the TypeScript SDK AddMemoryRequest with 6 optional fields matching Rust server types, tightening extension type annotations (record_type union literal, metadata Record type), and documenting the decay invariant and PPR/pinned separation in memory_store.rs and web_server.rs.

nodes.name: SDD Post-Session Hardening Tasks
nodes.summary: Comprehensive completed task checklist covering 8 sections: fixing 5 intelligence hook integration tests, fixing the CLI world model test, adding decay invariant doc comment to memory_store.rs, documenting PPR/pinned separation in web_server.rs and openapi_spec.rs, aligning TypeScript SDK types, tightening extension type annotations, promoting the scoring spec, and final verification steps.
